subject: Television & Streaming
title: Anime: Japan's Television Empire
description: A short lesson to help you apply Anime: Japan's Television Empire.

buildup.text: Anime covers every genre: romance, horror, science fiction, sports, cooking.

discovery.text: Crunchyroll, Funimation, and Netflix compete for anime streaming rights.

twist.text: Anime production is notoriously exploitative. Animators work extreme hours for low pay.

climax.text: Anime proved that animation is not a children's medium.

punchline.text: Japan drew a world that the world watches.

quiz.question: What misconception about anime does its global success challenge?
options: That Japanese content can't be exported
That animation is only for children—anime tells complex adult stories across every genre
That anime is only popular in Japan
